title: Unicode-escaped "signature" key bypasses both the byte filter and key watch
reason: false positive: the contains(b"signature") pre-filter is pre-existing, and bypassing it needs a host escaping key names and the signature_delta type value; no Anthropic-protocol host does; the documented bounds are size bounds

title: Frames with no parseable index pass through raw, so the signature can reach the client
reason: false positive: the early ? returns are pre-existing; fail-closed is documented for the two size bounds only; a block event without an integer index cannot be dispatched by the client

title: SignatureWrap state uses overlapping bool flags; consider a single mode enum
reason: out of scope: design suggestion, no defect (holding/skipping are mutually exclusive, closed is terminal); file-size split noted as a follow-up in the PR body

title: Fail-closed error is emitted as Ok bytes, so the chain does not record a failure
reason: false positive: failure accounting is frame-based — stream_metrics::observe_anthropic marks event: error frames as errors and TerminalScan treats them as terminal; gateway-owned error frames as Ok bytes have precedent (antigravity finish_with_error)

title: Multi-data-line join turns a frame of two JSON data lines from rewritten into passthrough
reason: false positive: joining data lines with \n is the SSE spec; a client sees the same invalid joined JSON and never dispatches the event

title: Malformed signature frames bypass the wrap and reach the client raw
reason: false positive: same as the rejected 'no parseable index' finding — the ? bail-outs are pre-existing, fail-closed is documented for the size bounds, and a block event with no integer index is not dispatched by the client

title: Signature key with 5+ spaces or tabs before colon is not recognised
reason: accepted residual, documented: no encoder emits more than 4 spaces/tabs between a key and its colon; MAX_KEY_GAP bounds the carried skip tail

title: Mid-frame fail-closed sends a truncated event that SDK clients cannot parse
reason: documented instead of changed: a half-forwarded event cannot be recalled, the client sees a parse error either way, and no raw signature is sent

title: Contract test body is empty in default (non-postgres) builds
reason: by design: store_contract_test! always emits a sqlite arm; a deliberate no-op sqlite body for Postgres-only behaviour is the macro's convention, and the postgres arm is cfg-gated inside the macro

title: BEGIN bound also covers pool acquire, so its message can misstate the cause
reason: refuted: pool acquire_timeout is 10 s (open.rs POSTGRES_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT) and caps the whole acquire incl. health ping, so the 15 s BEGIN bound can only fire with >=5 s spent in BEGIN itself

title: Abandoned COMMIT is a Database error that callers relabel CommitUncertain
reason: unreachable: timed_out is set only by a statement timeout whose Err every caller propagates before commit(); even if reached the settled read-back finds no commit

title: Statements on a timed-out transaction wait another 15 s instead of failing as abandoned
reason: unreachable: every caller propagates a statement timeout with ? before issuing another statement; even if one did, the cost is one extra bounded wait and commit is still refused as abandoned
